author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices a hand home from B, patterns that step up, a song sung twice, counting in threes and two-hand teamwork, with a Dublin street song.

classes.title: Thumb on B, next to C
classes.goal: Find the hand home from B to F and play the first line slowly.

mathTarget.parentLine: Using C and the black keys to place the whole hand

classes.parentPrompt: Find C left of the two black keys; help your child set the thumb one key left.
classes.childAction: Thumb on B, then one finger on each key up to F.
classes.bridge: C sits left of the two black keys; B is the doorstep just before it.

intro.caption: Find B, just left of C
intro.parentCue: Point to C first, then the key to its left

games.caption: One finger, one key
games.parentCue: Say the finger numbers together, one to five

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: placing the whole hand with a landmark.

classes.title: Same shape, one step up
classes.goal: Hear and play the second line: the first line's shape, one key higher.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same little tune, moved one key higher

classes.parentPrompt: Play line one, then line two; ask your child what changed and what stayed.
classes.childAction: Play the C pattern, then the same shape on D.
classes.bridge: C, C, C, hop to E, back to C; then the same walk one key up.

intro.caption: Same shape, one step up
intro.parentCue: ask what stayed the same, what moved

games.caption: On C, then one step up
games.parentCue: Point one key right when line two starts

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: spotting a pattern moved one key higher.

classes.title: One tune, sung twice
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly and find where the tune starts again.

mathTarget.parentLine: The second half is the first half again, new words

classes.parentPrompt: When the tune starts over at 'As she wheeled', say 'again!' and clap.
classes.childAction: Play slowly and say 'again!' when the tune starts over.
classes.bridge: The song is two trips down the same street: same turns, new words.

intro.caption: One tune, sung twice
intro.parentCue: Say 'again!' when the tune starts over

games.caption: Tap the beat: the first line
games.parentCue: Play the blue keys; your child taps the beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding where a song repeats.

classes.title: Alive, alive-o
classes.goal: Practise the ending slowly: down past C to B, then back home.

mathTarget.parentLine: Stepping just past home, then coming back to it

classes.parentPrompt: Say the finger numbers with your child: four, three, two, one, two.
classes.childAction: Walk down to your thumb on B, then step home to C.
classes.bridge: Molly walks one door past home to B, then turns back to C.

intro.caption: Watch slowly
intro.parentCue: Say the finger numbers aloud together

games.caption: Alive, alive-o: back home
games.parentCue: Sing 'alive, alive-o' slowly with the keys

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: a step past home and back.

classes.title: Low C, low G: the wheel
classes.goal: Play one low left hand note, C or G, on the first beat of each bar.

mathTarget.parentLine: Each bar has three beats; the left hand plays on one

classes.parentPrompt: Play the tune; count one-two-three each bar, loud on one, for your child's low note.
classes.childAction: Left hand plays low C or low G on every one.
classes.bridge: Low C is C in a lower house; low G lives a few doors up.

intro.caption: The wheel turns on one
intro.parentCue: count to three, loud on one

games.caption: One two three, one two three
games.parentCue: Say one loud with each low note

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: counting three beats and playing on one.

classes.title: The wheelbarrow rolls
classes.goal: Play the tune with a low left hand note on each bar, very slowly.

mathTarget.parentLine: One low note lasts while three beats go by above

classes.parentPrompt: Rest a hand on your child's left shoulder and say 'wheel' on each low note.
classes.childAction: Left hand holds the low note while the right hand walks the tune.
classes.bridge: Left hand is the barrow wheel, turning once a bar; right hand is Molly singing.

intro.caption: The wheelbarrow rolls
intro.parentCue: Say 'wheel' softly on each low note

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: two hands doing two jobs at once.

classes.title: Slow street, busy street
classes.goal: Play both hands together a little faster, then slow again if needed.

mathTarget.parentLine: The pattern stays the same when the speed changes

classes.parentPrompt: Walk two fingers slowly on the lid, then faster; go back to slow if notes fall apart.
classes.childAction: Play both hands slowly, then a little quicker.
classes.bridge: A quiet morning street and a busy market street: the same walk, different speed.

intro.caption: Slow street, busy street
intro.parentCue: Go back to slow if notes fall apart

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: the same song at two speeds.

classes.title: Down the Dublin streets
classes.goal: Play the whole song along with the music and keep going.

mathTarget.parentLine: Keeping your part in step while the music moves on

classes.parentPrompt: Sit beside your child and nod on every one; cheer for keeping going, not for notes.
classes.childAction: Play along with the music. If a note slips, keep walking!
classes.bridge: The music is the street; keep pushing the barrow to the end.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping your part in step with the music.

classes.title: Molly's street concert
classes.goal: Play the whole song for teddy and land softly home on C.

mathTarget.parentLine: Holding the song in order and landing on the home note

classes.parentPrompt: Seat teddy as the audience; clap, cheer and bow together at the end.
classes.childAction: Play for teddy, end softly on C, then bow.
classes.bridge: Molly calls out one last time, then the song rests at home on C.

intro.caption: A song for teddy
intro.parentCue: Seat teddy and announce the song together

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song and ending at home.
